paite: Numei pil in innte alam a; himahleh mihai in amah khut in aphelsia.
english: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

paite: Atang a gamtami in TOUPA akihta a; himahleh alampite a hoih lou in amah amusit hi.
english: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

paite: Mihai kam ah kisaktheihna chiang a-om; himahleh mipil mukte'n huaite ahawi ding hi.
english: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

paite: Bawngtalte omlouhna ah, anpiakna kuang asiang a; himahleh bawngtal hatna ziak in nakpi a punna a-om hi.
english: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

paite: Theihpih ginom in zuau agen kei ding; himahleh theihpih zuauthei in zuau agen hi.
english: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

paite: Musitmi in pilna azong a, amu kei hi; himahleh theihsiamna nei a ding in theihna abaih hi.
english: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

paite: Mihai a-omna ah lut in, amah ah theihna mukte na mu kei ding hi.
english: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

paite: Mipilvang pilna a lampi theihsiam ahi a; himahleh mihaite haina khemna ahi.
english: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

paite: Mihai in khelhna achiamnuihbawl a; himahleh mitangte lak ah deihsakna a-om hi.
english: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

paite: Lungtang in amah khatna athei a; huan mikhual in anopsakna atokbuai kei hi.
english: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

paite: Migiloute inn suksiat in a-om ding; himahleh mitang biakbuk apha ding hi.
english: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

paite: Mihing a dia lampi dik a kilawm a-om a, himahleh huai tawpna sihna lampite ahi.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

paite: Lungtang nuihna nangawn lungkhamna ahi a; huan vualnopna tawpna gikna ahi.
english: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

paite: Lungtang a nungtolhmi amah lampite a dimsak in a-om ding; huan mihoih amah mah a kipan a hihlungkim in a-om ding hi.
english: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

paite: Mimawl in thu chih a-um a; himahleh mipilvang in apaina hoihtak in a-en hi.
english: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

paite: Mipil in akihta a, gilou a kipan apaimang; himahleh mihai bel ngottat in, akimuang hi.
english: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

paite: Kuapeuh hehbaih haitak in agamta ding; huan ngaihtuah giloumi huat in a-om hi.
english: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

paite: Mimawl in haina aluah ding; himahleh mipilvang theihna khuksak in a-om ding.
english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

paite: Hoih mai ah hoih lou akun a; huan diktat kongpite ah gilou akun hi.
english: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

paite: Genthei amah inveng mahmah muhdah in a-om; himahleh hausa in lawm tampi anei hi.
english: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

paite: A-inveng musit in thil ahihkhial a; himahleh migenthei hehpih, ama'n nuam asa hi.
english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

paite: Hoih lou ngaihtuahte apaikhial kei uh maw? Himahleh zahngaihna leh thutak hoih ngaihtuah kiang ah a-om ding hi.
english: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

paite: Sepgimna tengteng ah phattuamna a-om; himahleh mukte houlimna taksapna lam kia ah apai hi.
english: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

paite: Mipilte ahauhsakna ua theih in a-om uhi; himahleh mihaite ahaina ua theih in a-om uhi.
english: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

paite: Theihpih dik in khate asuaktasak a; himahleh zuaugen in khemna a-omsak hi.
english: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

paite: TOUPA kihtakna ah muanna hat a-om a; huan atate'n bukna mun anei ding uh.
english: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

paite: TOUPA kihtak hinna tuikhuk ahi, sihna thangte a kipan paimangna ding in.
english: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

paite: Mipi tamna ah kumpipa thupina a-om; himahleh mipite omlouhna lal siatna ahi.
english: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

paite: Kuapeuh ahehhak theihsiamna thupi a kipan ahi; himahleh kuapeuh lungtom in haina atawisang hi.
english: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

paite: Lungtang hoih taksa a dia hinna ahi; himahleh hazatna guhte muatna ahi.
english: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

paite: Kuapeuh genthei nuaisiah in abawlpa simmoh ahi; himahleh kuapeuh tasam tung a zahngaihna nei in amah azahtak hi.
english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

paite: Migilou agitlouh hihna a paihlut in a-om a; himahleh midiktat in asihna ah lametna anei hi.
english: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

paite: Theihsiamna nei lungtang ah pilna akhawl a; himahleh mihaite sunglam pang a om kitheihsak in a-om hi.
english: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

paite: Diktatna in nam atawisang a; himahleh khelhna mi kuapeuh a ding in zahlakna ahi.
english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

paite: Sikha piltak a gamta kiang ah kumpipa deihsakna a-om a; himahleh zumna omsak tung ah athangpaihna a-om hi.
english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
